title: Store Opening Training Sign-Off Form
subtitle: A practical observed-practice training sign-off for store opening that connects identity, observations and evidence, decision authority, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original retail-operations observed-practice training sign-off for store opening covering opening readiness, evidence references, authorization, escalation, operating limits, disposition, and handoff without copying a third-party form.
use_case: Use when a opening lead opens one store opening record to plan instruction, observe practice, identify knowledge and authority limits, assign follow-up, and acknowledge the resulting work scope; closure requires a documented outcome, evidence route, responsible owner, and recipient acknowledgment.

sections.title: Opening training sign-off identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this training sign-off to one location, operating period, accountable owner, and review route.

blocks.label: Opening event scope, trigger, affected area, and prior handoff

fields.label: Store Opening scope and routing context

sections.title: Opening training plan and learner route
sections.guidance: Define the procedure revision, learning method, practice setting, supervisor, and authorized scope.

blocks.label: Opening competencies
items: Plans entry without exposing access credentials
Performs exterior observation before entry
Records key and alarm custody correctly
Conducts an ordered interior walkthrough
Distinguishes stop conditions from routine defects
Routes cash readiness to the cash procedure
Checks customer-facing systems and zones
Assigns exceptions with owners and due points
Makes and communicates the opening decision
Completes handoff and record retention

blocks.label: Training and authorization boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not enter, confront a person, disturb suspected evidence, or open to the public when conditions exceed current authorization. Record objective observations and references only; never place alarm codes, safe combinations, or reusable credentials in this form. Follow applicable store, emergency, safety, privacy, and security policy and route judgment to the authorized reviewer. This sign-off records observed practice and assigned limits; it is not a license, professional certification, or guarantee of future performance.

sections.title: Opening coached practice and evidence
sections.guidance: Record the scenario, learner action, observable result, coaching, and next attempt rather than a generic pass mark.

blocks.label: Exception scenarios reviewed
items: Entry delayed or access unavailable
Opening stopped for unsafe condition
Alarm response or security review needed
Critical system or utility unavailable
Cash custody not reconciled
Public opening delayed or limited

blocks.label: Strengths, repeated errors, prompts required, evidence references, and conditions for another observation

sections.title: Opening knowledge check, limits, and escalation
sections.guidance: Confirm that the learner can identify sources, stop conditions, authorization limits, escalation owners, and handoff evidence.

blocks.label: Condition and exception knowledge
items: Door, lock, glass, or exterior damage
Alarm, access, or key-control exception
Water, odor, utility, or equipment concern
Unexpected person, delivery, or overnight activity
Customer-area cleanliness or trip concern
POS, network, refrigeration, or lighting outage
Opening float or safe handoff incomplete
Staffing or trained-keyholder shortage

blocks.label: Knowledge gaps, restricted tasks, retraining topics, interim supervision, and evidence needed

fields.label: Store Opening knowledge gaps and limits

sections.title: Opening work authorization and follow-up plan
sections.guidance: Grant only the observed scope and state the supervision, expiry, reassessment, or restriction that applies.

blocks.label: Training authorization handoff
items: Readiness decision communicated to scheduler
Restricted tasks visible to supervising owner
Procedure version and practice evidence linked
Coach accepted follow-up responsibility
Reassessment date or trigger recorded
Learner can identify the escalation route

sections.title: Opening outcome, closeout, and handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and acceptance visible.

blocks.label: Opening closeout controls
items: Opening status communicated to store team
Unresolved work has an owner and due point
Cash and key custody handed to named owners
Service desk and sales floor release recorded
Facilities or vendor follow-up reference linked
Opening record stored in the approved location

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Unresolved work, customer or staff impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Store Opening residual work and handoff

blocks.label: Training Sign-Off closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not a legal, safety, or professional certification.
